verdict.rationale: Washington DOR's documented services (business licensing, excise-tax filing, deductions, payments, amendments) all run through the interactive My DOR web portal, by mail, or by phone. The evidence pack documents no public API at all, let alone one with parity to the UI. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, and the transactional portal redirects every request to an authenticated login. A revenue agency could plausibly offer filing APIs, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
